title: Upscayl: free Topaz Gigapixel alternative
caption:
Topaz Gigapixel charges $149/year. Upscayl makes blurry photos sharp for free 🔍

✅ Enlarges small, low-res images with AI in one click
✅ Different AI models for photos and digital art
✅ Before/after slider and batch mode for many images
✅ No subscription, no account, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ It needs a graphics card that supports Vulkan, and many built-in (integrated) laptop GPUs won't work.

Comment "UPSCALE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
